insight: Made by Beijing's VAST AI, which co-released the open-source TripoSR model with Stability AI in 2024.
name: Tripo
tagline: Fast text- and image-to-3D model generation.
description: Generate detailed 3D models from a prompt or a single image in seconds, with texturing and clean topology options. Known for speed and an accessible free tier.
edge: One of the fastest image/text-to-3D generators with clean topology options and a generous free tier — speed over polish.
